info.name: Gym Backend API
info.description:
HTTP collection for the gymBackend Express API.

Setup:
1. Select environment Gym Backend — Local (or set baseUrl).
2. Set email, lane (CLIENT|STAFF), and name.
3. Run Auth > Email OTP > Request OTP, paste OTP into otpToken.
4. Run Verify OTP — stores accessToken, refreshToken, userId.
5. Authenticated requests use collection Bearer {{accessToken}}.

AI / client integration:
- Every request documents Response type, success status + body shape, and error codes.
- Open Examples on each request for concrete success and error JSON bodies.
- Shared error envelope: { error: { code: string, message: string } }.

Auth model:
- Public: /health, /auth/otp/request, /auth/otp/verify, /auth/google/start
- Bearer identity: /auth/google/complete
- Bearer provisioned: /auth/me, /gym-orgs

request.description:
POST /auth/otp/request — public. Sends a one-time code to the email.

**Request body (JSON):** `{ email: string }` only. Lane is NOT accepted here — pass lane on Verify OTP.

**Response type:** `application/json`
**Success:** `202` `{ status: "OTP_SENT" }`
**Errors (shared envelope `{ error: { code, message } }`):**
- `422` `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `EMAIL_ADDRESS_INVALID`
- `429` `AUTH_RATE_LIMITED`
- `502` `OTP_DELIVERY_FAILED`

After success, paste the emailed OTP into collection variable `otpToken`, then run Verify OTP.

request.description:
POST /auth/otp/verify — public. Verifies OTP and provisions the app user.

**Request body (JSON):**
- `email` string (required)
- `token` string 6–12 chars (required) — use `{{otpToken}}`
- `lane` enum `CLIENT` | `STAFF` (required)
- `name` string 1–120 (optional)

**Response type:** `application/json`
**Success:** `200`
```
{
  session: { accessToken: string, refreshToken: string, expiresIn: number },
  user: {
    id, email, name, lane,
    roleCode,          // CLIENT → CLIENT; STAFF → STAFF_UNASSIGNED
    staffCode,         // null for CLIENT; string for STAFF
    emailVerifiedAt    // ISO-8601 | null
  }
}
```
**Errors:** `422` OTP_EXPIRED | VALIDATION_ERROR | EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED; `409` LANE_MISMATCH; `429` AUTH_RATE_LIMITED.

Tests store accessToken, refreshToken, expiresIn, userId on collection + environment.

request.description:
POST /auth/google/complete — Bearer identity (Supabase Google session token). Provisions the app user; does not rotate tokens.

**Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` (Google session access token)
**Request body (JSON):** `{ lane: "CLIENT"|"STAFF", name?: string }`

**Response type:** `application/json`
**Success:** `200` `{ user: { id, email, name, lane, roleCode, staffCode, emailVerifiedAt } }`
**Errors:** `401` AUTHENTICATION_FAILED; `422` VALIDATION_ERROR | GOOGLE_IDENTITY_REQUIRED | EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED; `409` LANE_MISMATCH.

request.description:
GET /auth/google/start — public. Starts Google OAuth via Supabase.

**Response type:** HTTP redirect (no JSON body)
**Success:** `302`/`303`/`307`/`308` with `Location` → Supabase `/auth/v1/authorize?provider=google&redirect_to=...`
**Errors:** `503` `OAUTH_CONFIGURATION` when Host/callback config is missing.

Open the resolved URL in a browser. After consent, copy `access_token` from the callback URL hash into `accessToken`, then run Complete Google Auth.

item.name: Gym Orgs
item.description: Gym organization create/list. Requires provisioned Bearer {{accessToken}}. Create requires STAFF_UNASSIGNED or ADMIN.

request.description:
POST /gym-orgs — create a gym organization. Requires provisioned STAFF/ADMIN actor (roleCode STAFF_UNASSIGNED or ADMIN).

**Auth:** collection Bearer `{{accessToken}}`
**Request body (JSON):**
- `name` string (required)
- `address` string | null (optional, max 2000)
- `contactPhone` string | null (optional, max 50)
- `contactEmail` string | null (optional email)
- `logoUrl` string | null (optional URL)
- `timezone` string (optional, default `Asia/Kolkata`)

**Response type:** `application/json`
**Success:** `201` `{ gymOrg: { id, name, address, contactPhone, contactEmail, logoUrl, timezone, ownerUserId, createdAt, updatedAt } }`
**Errors:** `401` AUTHENTICATION_FAILED; `403` GYM_ORG_CREATION_FORBIDDEN; `422` VALIDATION_ERROR.
